# Try Omarchy v0.6.1

Download **TryOmarchy.exe** below, or let your installed launcher update itself. Your guest disk, files and settings carry over.

- **Alt+Tab can go back to Windows.** Settings > General has a new "Send Alt+Tab to Omarchy while its window is focused" checkbox. It's on by default, so nothing changes unless you turn it off. With it off, Alt+Tab opens the Windows task switcher like it did before v0.1.0. The change applies right away without restarting Omarchy.
- **No more black screen after a long sleep.** On laptops with Modern Standby, waking Windows after more than a few minutes could make Omarchy restart core services, leaving a black desktop or dropping you back to the login screen. Those restarts no longer happen.
- **Your monitor scale sticks.** A scale set in `~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua` now survives theme switches and `hyprctl reload` instead of snapping back to the automatic value.
- Omarchy's packages are refreshed to current Arch versions.

See the [compatibility guide](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy-windows/blob/master/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for hardware requirements and known limits.
